title: KALLAX shelving unit (5×5)
scope: Manual steps 1–24: assembling and raising the frame. Excludes wall attachment (p27–p35) and all inserts.

overview.title: Check the parts
overview.hint: Check the panels and hardware against p5–p7. Only the frame hardware is used here; set the wall-attachment hardware aside.

1.title: Top panel + left side panel
1.hint: Join the top panel and the left side panel at a right angle and drive in 2 long screws with the Z-shaped hex key.

2.title: Dowels for row 1 dividers
2.hint: For the 4 dividers of row 1, hammer 2 dowels into one edge of each.

3.title: Row 1 dividers
3.hint: Insert the 4 dividers into the top panel.

4.title: Dowels for the long shelves
4.hint: Hammer dowels into both ends of the 4 long shelves, 32 in total.

5.title: Long shelf 1
5.hint: Press the long shelf onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

6.title: Row 2 dowels
6.hint: On long shelf 1, hammer in 8 dowels for the next row of dividers.

8.title: Long shelf 2
8.hint: Press long shelf 2 onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

11.title: Long shelf 3
11.hint: Press long shelf 3 onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

14.title: Long shelf 4
14.hint: Press long shelf 4 onto the dividers and into the left side panel.

16.title: Row 5 dividers
16.hint: Fit the last row of 4 dividers.

17.title: Right side panel
17.hint: Turn the second side panel over and fit it onto the ends of all long shelves; mind the direction of the holes.

18.title: Top-right corner screws
18.hint: Drive 2 long screws into the corner between the right side panel and the top panel.

19.title: Last row of dowels
19.hint: Hammer 8 dowels into the exposed ends of the last row of dividers.

20.title: Bottom panel
20.hint: Turn the grey bottom panel over and fit it on.

21.title: Bottom panel screws
21.hint: Drive 2 long screws into each corner of the bottom panel, 4 in total.

22.title: Felt pads
22.hint: Stick 12 felt pads onto the grey face of the bottom panel.

23.title: Lift
23.hint: Two people lift the unit; mind where to hold it.

24.title: Raise
24.hint: Two people turn the unit upright. The next step is wall attachment (not covered here).
